A space-only italic nested inside an otherwise empty strong wrapper still separates the words on either side

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><i> </i></strong>Beta</p>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
